summary: “Why am I compelled to write?... Because the world I create in the writing compensates for what the real world does not give me. By writing I put order in the world, give it a handle so I can grasp it." -Gloria E. Anzaldúa #quote
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
“Why am I compelled to write?... Because the world I create in the writing compensates for what the real world does not give me. By writing I put order in the world, give it a handle so I can grasp it."
-Gloria E. Anzaldúa
#quote
